utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you start by sorting the donated items and setting aside anything that’s too worn to use? I’ll swing back once I’ve got the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll sort the donated items now and set aside anything too worn to use.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’m still checking the details, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll let you know the plan as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that’d really help. I may have missed a few things, so just let me know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick look and tally it up, then I’ll let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey—could you check what supplies we already have and let me know if you can bring any tools? I’m trying to avoid doubling up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll check what we already have and see which tools I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think so — I’m pretty sure it’s still happening, but I’m waiting on the latest update. Did anything change?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not that I’ve heard. I just wanted to check whether you’d heard the latest yet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s coming along nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. Want me to keep an ear out for what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Tess — thanks. If you hear they need hammers, screwdrivers, or extension cords, let me know and I’ll round them up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if hammers, screwdrivers, or extension cords are still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’d be happy to spread the word—when and where is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s happening this Saturday at the community center on Maple Street, from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let folks know! Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what kind of items you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We still need the most: basic tools, screws and nails, fresh paint, and a few cleaning supplies. If you have anything like that, it’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure thing, Bo — I can help organize the repair drive and keep things moving. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll start from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — let’s start with the broken fence panels and the leaky mailbox. I’ll keep it simple and just point out the biggest stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll put the fence panels and mailbox at the top of the list, and we can tackle the rest after that. If you notice anything else big, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to everyone I see and keep the plans moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: mention it to folks and we’ll check in after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll mention the repair drive to folks and we can check in after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder on where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. We’re meeting by the community shed at 6—no rush if you’re running late.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli—community shed at 6. I’ll do my best to be there, and if I’m late I’ll find you there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and point people to the sign-up list?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send people to the sign-up list. If you want, I can also help remind a few neighbors directly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together the repair drive invites now — want me to make sure you’re on the list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please put me on the list — I may join a bit late, but I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you on the list, and I’ll save you a spot even if you arrive late.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Could you help sort the donated tools and then label the repair bins so we can keep everything organized?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the repair bins.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times if that makes the repair drive easier.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Faye — thank you. I’ll note your help around pickup and drop-off so we can make the repair drive as smooth as possible.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send me the pickup and drop-off windows, and I’ll work around them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect folks for the repair drive and keep everyone on the same page. What still needs to be coordinated?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — we still need to line up the volunteers, confirm the tool drop-off, and make sure everyone knows the start time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can reach out to the volunteer group and confirm who’s bringing what. Once I’ve got the drop-off details, I’ll share the start time with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — I can lend a hand and bring over whatever tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. Can you let me know which tools you’re bringing so I can make sure we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring my hammer, screwdriver set, tape measure, and a wrench or two. If you think of anything else, just let me know and I’ll add it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is set up—do you want me to check if it’s still by the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes please, Opal—that would be great. If it’s moved, let me know and I’ll update everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll check by the community center and let you know if it’s been moved.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first so I don’t miss anything — once I’ve confirmed the list, I’ll let you know the latest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you send me the confirmed list when you have it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we’re short on screwdrivers, duct tape, and a few extension cords. If you can bring any of those, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring screwdrivers and duct tape for sure, and I’ll check for an extension cord too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming together—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I might’ve missed the latest update, but I know they were still looking for a few tools and some extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I'll ask around and see if anyone can spare a few tools or help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — I heard they’re setting everything up for this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm still a bit foggy on the details, but I'm happy to help however I can. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — could you help sort donated tools and label the boxes? That’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely—I can do that. Just point me to the boxes and I’ll get sorting and labeling.
